description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of a broad tree bough as wide as a road: grey-brown bark with fine cracks, scattered green oak leaves, a few small acorns, patches of pale lichen, muted very dark palette of grey-brown, leaf green and pale silver, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
